payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and results related to recovering from noisy entity linking in the context of query generation.

claims.text: The system can still generate correct answers in 85% of cases despite a decline in precision due to noisy entity linking.
SubQG filters out many erroneous linking results through checks like empty query and domain/range checks, improving recovery from noise.
With increased training data, the query substructure approaches show stable improvements in precision and recall, aiding recovery from noise.
